title: Correct turns ratio
description: Essential: The answer must give the turns ratio as 1:20 or equivalent (e.g., 0.05).

title: Correct transmission current
description: Essential: The answer must give the transmission current as approximately 0.90 A or 0.909 A.

title: Applies transformer voltage ratio
description: Important: The solution correctly uses the relationship n1/n2 = U1/U2 with the given voltages.

title: Uses correct power formula
description: Important: The transmission current is calculated using I = P / U with the high transmission voltage (220 kV).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution shows proper unit conversion (kW to W, kV to V) or explicitly states units are consistent.

title: Confuses input/output voltages
description: Pitfall: Using the plant output voltage (11 kV) instead of the transmission voltage (220 kV) to calculate the transmission current.

title: Incorrect ratio direction
description: Pitfall: Stating the turns ratio as 20:1 (secondary:primary) instead of the requested primary:secondary (1:20).
